description: This Java source file defines the 'ModifyAclEntryStrategy' class, which handles 'ModifyAclEntry' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class applies modifications to an Access Control List (ACL) of a Thing, validating the changes and generating corresponding events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: Final class that implements the strategy for handling 'ModifyAclEntry' commands, modifying the ACL of a Thing, validating changes, and producing corresponding events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the application of the 'ModifyAclEntry' command, modifying the ACL if valid, and returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: getAclValidator
methods.description: Creates a new validator instance for the given ACL.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing ACL entry or create a new one, and returns the corresponding result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating the ACL entry was modified, including the event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating a new ACL entry was created, including the event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for concurrency control based on the ACL entry related to the command.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the new entity tag after applying the ACL entry modification.
